title: Delightful Mexican Halal Date Tacos
description: A sweet and savory twist on traditional Mexican cuisine, featuring halal beef and medjool dates. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: 1. Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
3. Add the medjool dates, Delight Mexican Seasoning, lime juice, cumin, coriander, and salt to the skillet.
4. Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
5. Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
6. Assemble the tacos by spooning the beef mixture onto a tortilla and topping with shredded cheese.
7. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
8. Cook the tortillas for an additional 30-60 seconds on each side, until slightly charred and crispy.
9. Repeat the assembly process until all of the beef mixture and tortillas are used.
